the accuracy of the decision tree in the diagnosing of heart disease could be enhanced by using different methods of initial k-means centroid selection such as inlier and outlier methods.
the accuracy of the Decision Tree is increased when it is integrated with K-means clustering and the initial centroid selection method has a great impact on the results of the K-means clustering.
the inlier method is the most suitable initial centroid selection method in the diagnosis of patients with heart disease.

the development of new methods for initial centroid selection of k-means clustering.
the integration of decision tree and k-means clustering to improve the diagnosis of heart diseases.
the integration of k-means clustering and decision tree with different centroid selection methods in diagnosing heart disease.

the inlier, outlier and random attribute values methods of initial centroid selections are the best methods for the diagnosis of heart diseases.
the inlier method of initial centroid selection could achieve higher accuracy in the diagnosis of patients with heart disease.
the integration of K-means clustering with different initial centroid methods in the diagnosis heart disease patients could enhance the performance of the decision tree in the diagnosing patients.
